scenario.title: Unexpected Interruption During Live Broadcast
scenario.context: A local TV station during the evening news broadcast
scenario.description: The evening news is being broadcast live when a technical glitch occurs. A loud, unexpected noise suddenly interrupts the broadcast. The anchor, Keshav, and the director, Maria, are in conversation through their headsets.
scenario.speaker1_persona: Calm, professional, and understanding. He understands the importance of maintaining composure on live TV and values the morale of the team.
scenario.speaker2_persona_1: High EQ - She is composed, patient, and solution-oriented. She maintains her cool even under stress and communicates effectively while managing the situation.
scenario.speaker2_persona_2: Low EQ - She is impulsive and easily flustered. She reacts immediately with frustration and panic, leading to rushed decisions and ineffective communication.
scenario.speaker2_persona_3: Low EQ - She is quick to anger and tends to blame others. She lacks patience and her communication is driven by her frustration and desire to find a scapegoat.
